node.statement: Lemma 5.4 (First moment of GPS, general): For any state psi_sym on Sym^n(C^d), E[sigma_hat_v] = (psi_sym)_1, the single-copy marginal. Proof: Apply Proposition 5.1 with k=1 and Lemma 5.2. Compute tr_{1..n}((1/n)X_{n+1}(Pi_sym^n tensor I)(psi_sym tensor I)). Using Proposition 2.4 (partial trace with SWAP), this reduces to (psi_sym)_1.
